metadata.description: Plugins by Julian Dickie / Institute of Digital Dentistry. Currently ships LinkedIn Post Studio; future plugins for content creation and dental education will be added here.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-studio
plugins.description: Profile-driven LinkedIn content generation — text posts, carousels, hooks, polls, video scripts, newsletters, calendars, companion comments, QA review, idea mining, content repurposing, and post teardowns. Built on a comprehensive 2025–2026 LinkedIn knowledge base, with built-in defenses against AI slop.
